enforced_signing_conditions: 1. Requested key_id exists in the authorized signing-key registry (SIGNING_KEY_NOT_FOUND)
2. Key is active for signing in lifecycle metadata (SIGNING_KEY_NOT_AUTHORIZED)
3. Key has not been revoked in SigningKeyRegistry (SIGNING_KEY_REVOKED)
4. Key is explicitly authorized for REPLICATION_ATTESTATION_SIGNING purpose (SIGNING_KEY_NOT_AUTHORIZED)
5. Caller holds an unforgeable HMAC-sealed server-side SigningAuthorityContext with an open session (SIGNING_AUTHORITY_NOT_GRANTED)
6. Signing operation is permitted in the current runtime environment and outside public API handlers (SIGNING_OPERATION_NOT_PERMITTED)
